derivedFrom: PACKAGE-API-CHECKLIST.md (W4 executes-green / correct-refusal sets, 2026-08-25 host probe)

classes.executes-green: Cheap enough for the default sweep pass; expected to execute and exit 0.
classes.typed-refusal: Expected to fail fast with a typed refusal whose message contains `refusal.substring`; cheap to run.
classes.heavy: Force-scale build/test cost; the sweep runs it only with --heavy. `expect` says what the run must produce.
classes.service: Long-running Serve target (or a test that boots one); the sweep runs it only with --services and probes readiness.

expect.refusal: nonzero exit and the declared refusal substring in the combined output
expect.red: nonzero exit that is an honest failure of the checked work, not a refusal (e.g. generator drift)
expect.ready: reaches readiness (a line matching /ready|listening|healthy/i), then shuts down cleanly on SIGTERM

refusalCodes.host-bin-absent: declared S.Host.bin missing from PATH; message must name the bin
refusalCodes.missing-secret: declared S.Secret unset at spawn; message must name the secret
refusalCodes.approval-required: approval: "required" with no interactive approver; message must contain 'approval'
refusalCodes.needs-input: Agent payload missing headless; message must contain 'payload'
refusalCodes.memory-unavailable: S.Memory.* with smithers cloud unreachable/unconfigured; message must contain 'memory'
refusalCodes.script-precondition: the target's own script refuses a stated precondition; matched by substring only

doc.alternates: Legitimate second outcomes where the checklist is ambiguous or environment-dependent; the sweep reports them as 'alternate', which passes but is listed separately.
doc.mutates: Running the target writes into the workspace tree; the sweep resets the clone (git checkout + clean, preserving node_modules/.flows/.env.shared) after it.
